scopeAndLimits: No model workload, core changes or business workspaces used in this context audit. Existing independent completed Flash approval test session only.

The provider advertises Flash 1M; exact 1048576 is this configured catalog value, not measured max-window acceptance in this audit.

last.totalTokens includes output, cached input remains within input and reasoning within output. It omits not-yet-sampled appended local messages/tools and may differ from native auto-compaction active-context estimate.
Native TUI remaining-percent helper also subtracts a 12000 fixed baseline; this Web full-window-used fraction is a different, explicitly stated metric.

Native tokenUsage event contains no model ID; frontend labels it using thread settings at receipt. Cross-model historical attribution has source-based uncertainty; all real model validation remains Flash.
